annotation: Beitrag zur Sammlung »The Progress of English Poetry« (INr 130152, Obj 15)
incipit_statement: Sweet Spirit from that lovely bondage free / Of flux mortality; / Free from the cares that rudely press / The mourner that companionless / Must onwards tread life’s wilderness.
preferred_title: TO THE MEMORY OF A BELOVED WIFE. / (Lines written in the time of Charles I.) / 1645
